visual_checks.contents: Overview, model qualifiers and two visibly distinct GIF rotation frames, 1.1 seconds apart.
Logistic optical law, six aligned state equations and stated theorem hypotheses.
Complete three-panel continuation/fold figure: turning branch, nontrivial multiplier crossing +1, and physical-displacement projections. Labels distinguish periodic cycles from chaotic attractors.
Normalized three-state equations and 3x3 analytic Jacobian, source periodic-parameter table, physical rate restrictions, numerical closure/priority caveats and command examples.
Complete section-distance/return/projection PNG, two visibly different GIF orientations, section projector and two-complete/one-incomplete/one-unstarted Radau qualification.
Repaired inline b=1 label and newly added stable-plane equation, flow identities and restricted conclusion. The previous raw-math failure was visually inspected separately.

source_screenshots: Ignored outputs/publication-check only; browser UI screenshots are not redistributed under the repository license.
limits: Sixteen distinct pages at their individually recorded revisions and a desktop viewport; not every page, browser or mobile layout.
Initial public visibility, license, GIF-motion and clicked-link observations retain their a514509 revision/timestamps and were not implicitly rerun.
The all-Markdown link check validates relative paths, not every external reference or fragment.
Rendering and image animation do not validate scientific novelty or numerical correctness.
No new simulation or dependency installation was run by this browser audit; public-clone validation is a separate record.

The publication-check note version present at 006e3ce was inspected. The additional audit metadata and this second-pass description were written afterward and are not certified by that earlier page load.
